sql: SELECT coalesce(m.metadata->>'source', '(sem)') AS origem, left(m.content, 40) AS texto, to_char(m.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'DD/MM HH24:MI') AS hora, m.metadata::text AS meta FROM wapi_messages m JOIN wapi_conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE c.remote_jid LIKE '5511947594084%' AND m.from_me = true ORDER BY m.timestamp DESC LIMIT 25
